MTV International rebrand, 2015

MTV’s international on-air identity of June 2015, which critics described as pastel, badly 3D-modelled, and borrowed from vaporwave and seapunk.

Source
Motherboard: What the Hell Is MTV’s New Rebrand About?
Creator
MTV International (creative lead Sean Saylor, per Motherboard)
Made
June 25, 2015
Style
Vaporwave (corporate adoption; agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Frenetic, ironic, commercial
Evidence
Relies on Motherboard and Wikipedia. No still or video of the idents was inspected.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Clinton Nguyen, Motherboard, June 25, 2015: the new look is “pastel-swatched, bad 3D modeling, and visual features drawn directly from Tumblr-born microcultures,” with the slogan changed to “I am my MTV.” Sean Saylor, MTV’s vice-president of creative and marketing, is quoted on refreshing the look constantly. Motherboard.

Wikipedia: on the same day that MTV International introduced the rebrand, Tumblr launched Tumblr TV “with an explicitly MTV-styled visual spin.” Motherboard’s Jordan Pearson wrote that the style’s cynical impulse is “co-opted and erased.” Wikipedia: Vaporwave.

Why it belongs

The point at which the style became a brand look for the kind of company it satirised. The criticism is part of the record: a corporate use of vaporwave reads as either knowing or tone-deaf.
